sources.rainfall: CHIRPS v2.0 daily, 0.05 deg (Funk et al. 2015), UCSB Climate Hazards Center
sources.temperature: ERA5 daily maximum 2 m temperature and FAO-56 reference evapotranspiration (ECMWF/Copernicus) via Open-Meteo archive API
sources.vegetation: MODIS MOD13Q1/MYD13Q1 v6.1 250 m 16-day NDVI (NASA LP DAAC) via Microsoft Planetary Computer
sources.yields: Crop Estimates Committee (SAGIS) and HarvestStat Africa v1.2; commercial white + yellow maize by province
sources.yield_check: DAFF Abstract of Agricultural Statistics 2018, Table 9

definitions.season: planting year Y = the Y/Y+1 summer crop
definitions.rain_flowering_mm: CHIRPS total over this district-season's flowering window: green-up +30 to +65 days (fallback ((1, 15), (2, 15)))
definitions.water_balance_mm: CHIRPS rainfall minus FAO-56 reference evapotranspiration, ((10, 1), (3, 31))
definitions.greenup_doy: day of year when cropland NDVI first passes 50% of the season's amplitude, searched over ((10, 1), (2, 28)) (negative = before 1 January)
definitions.dry_spell_days: longest run of days < 1.0 mm within ((12, 1), (3, 31))
definitions.ndvi_peak: max of 3-composite running median of cropland NDVI within ((12, 1), (4, 30))
definitions.ndvi_anomaly: ndvi_peak minus district mean over seasons 2000-2014
definitions.yield_tha: provincial commercial maize (white + yellow) production / area planted
